title: Xup config
description: Xup 的全部配置（单一事实来源）。文件位于 ~/Library/Application Support/Xup/config.json；App 运行时会监听并热加载（约 0.5 秒）。Xup settings: the single source of truth, hot-reloaded by the running app.

$schema.description: 指向本 schema 的相对路径（App 自动写入）。Path to this schema, written by the app.

version.description: 配置格式版本，目前固定为 1。Config format version (currently 1).

check.description: 定时检查相关设置。Scheduled check settings.

intervalMinutes.description: 定时检查间隔（分钟），0 表示关闭定时检查；界面最小 5。Minutes between scheduled checks; 0 disables.

notify.description: 发现更新时发送系统通知。Post a notification when updates are found.

autoUpdate.description: 定时检查发现更新后自动执行更新（可能退出正在使用的应用）。Automatically install updates found by scheduled checks.

homebrew.description: Homebrew 来源设置。Homebrew provider settings.

greedy.description: brew outdated/upgrade 加 --greedy，把自带更新机制的 cask 也列为可更新。Pass --greedy to include auto-updating casks.

ui.description: 界面与系统集成。UI and system integration.

showUpToDate.description: 列表中显示已是最新的条目。Show up-to-date items in lists.

launchAtLogin.description: 登录时启动 Xup（仅打包为 .app 时生效）。Launch Xup at login (app bundle only).

electron.description: electron-updater 应用的下载策略。Download policy for electron-updater apps.

deltaDownload.description: 使用 blockmap 增量下载（只下载变化的块）。Use blockmap delta downloads.

keepVersionsPerApp.description: 每个应用在缓存中保留的旧版本安装包数量（供增量下载复用）。Old installer versions kept per app for delta reuse.

agent.description: agent / CLI 相关的安全边界。Safety switches for agents using the xup CLI.

allowUpdates.description: 为 true 时 `xup update` 不再要求 --yes。When true, `xup update` does not require --yes.

tracked.description: 关注列表：每个来源只检查/更新这里列出的条目（应用见 apps）。Watch lists per provider; only listed items are checked/updated.

homebrew.description: Homebrew formula / cask 的 token，如 "node"、"iina"。Homebrew tokens.

npm.description: npm 全局包名，如 "typescript"、"@openai/codex"。Global npm package names.

uv.description: uv tool 名，如 "nox"。uv tool names.

agent.description: agent 可执行名（agents.json 中的 binary），如 "claude"、"codex"。Agent binaries.

skill.description: Vercel skills CLI 安装的 skill 名。Skill names from ~/.agents/.skill-lock.json.

path.description: 应用包的绝对路径，如 /Applications/IINA.app。Absolute path to the .app bundle.

restartAfterUpdate.description: 更新完成后重新启动该应用。Relaunch the app after updating.

source.description: 手动指定的更新来源；null 或省略表示自动识别（Homebrew cask > Sparkle > electron-updater > App Store）。Manual update source; null = auto-detect.

githubReleases.description: GitHub Releases 最新 Release。Latest GitHub release.

assetPattern.description: 资源文件名通配（fnmatch），如 "*arm64*.dmg"；省略时自动选择匹配本机架构的 .dmg/.zip。Asset name glob.

tauri.description: Tauri 更新器 JSON。Tauri updater JSON endpoint.

url.description: 完整 JSON 地址。Full URL of the updater JSON.
latest-mac.yml 的完整 URL。Full URL of latest-mac.yml.
appcast.xml 的完整 URL。Full URL of the appcast.
